name: Corning 3601 96 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Corning 96 well black polystyrene microplate with a clear flat bottom, high binding surface, supplied without lid, non-sterile, 25 per bag. Corning's own per-catalog Product Description calls it 'Costar(R) 96-well plate, high binding, black with clear flat bottom, without lid' (rev 10, 2026-03-15) while the catalog page calls it 'Corning(R) 96-well Black/Clear Flat Bottom Polystyrene High Bind Microplate'; both are the same part. Units in meters. Corning publishes no per-catalog-number drawing for its assay plates, so the controlling document is the family sheet 'Microplate Dimensions 96/384/1536', row '96 well flat bottom' under 'Black/white with clear bottom, polystyrene plates', where 3601 is named explicitly. From that row: well spacing (pitch) 9 mm, well depth 10.67 mm, well top diameter 6.86 mm, bottom diameter 6.35 mm, flat bottom, A1 well center 14.3 mm from the left edge (Corning 'A1 column offset') and 11.2 mm from the top edge ('A1 row offset'), flange/skirt height 6.096 mm, stack height 13.12 mm, well bottom elevation 3.55 mm, well bottom area 0.3165 cm^2, total well volume 360 uL (working volume 75-200 uL per the catalog page). Plate footprint 127.76 x 85.48 x 14.22 mm per the Corning and Falcon Microplates Selection Guide (CLS-C-DL-MP-014REV9), which Corning states meets the ANSI/SBS footprint standard; the family sheet rounds this to 127.8 x 85.5 x 14.2 mm. Well bottom thickness 0.5 mm: the outside of the well floor sits 3.03 mm above the plate datum, against 2.26 mm on a solid-bottom 1.27 mm plate such as the Corning 3599, so swapping between the two is a 0.77 mm working-distance shift. Corning's catalog page states the bottoms are '60% thinner than conventional polystyrene plates'. Geometrically identical to the Corning 3610 already in this registry; they differ only in body color (3601 black, 3610 white) and surface (3601 high binding, 3610 TC-treated). Corning dimensions this row at the family level, so the same numbers cover 3603, 3604, 3610, 3631, 3632, 3635, 3651, 3666, 3667, 3723, 3903, 3904 and 3340 - no dimension here was measured on a 3601 specifically. Cross-checked against the per-catalog Product Description (https://certs-ecatalog.corning.com/life-sciences/product-descriptions/3601.pdf), which gives 5.030 x 3.365 in footprint, 0.560 in height without lid, 0.420 in well depth, 0.270/0.250 in well diameters and 0.36 mL per well at a +/- 0.010 in tolerance - all agreeing with the family sheet. Use 'pitch' and origin reference to compute all well centers.
